# AgentOps

> Turns a codebase into a knowledge graph AI coding agents can query — scanning, hybrid search, curated gotchas/decisions, and library docs, exposed over MCP and self-hosted as a single open-core product (one Rust server, one Next.js frontend, no price gate).

AgentOps scans a repo into a persistent graph of files/symbols/dependencies, layers hybrid dense+lexical search on top, and adds a curated Gotchas/Decisions notes system for tribal knowledge. Agents reach all of it over one MCP server (up to 38 tools, depending on the surface and access mode: code graph, notes, tasks, sessions/usage, library docs), either as a local stdio binary or through a hosted server's authenticated `/mcp` endpoint. Humans use a REST API and web UI. `docbrain`, a bundled subsystem, scrapes and indexes third-party library documentation for search. A local server registers AgentOps's own docs as a library (metadata only) on boot; run `scrape_library` with `slug: agentops` to ingest them.

Self-hosting needs exactly one required value (`AGENTOPS_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY`) and supports Docker, a classic binary install, PM2, or Kubernetes. Client machines connect with `curl -fsSL <server>/connect.sh | sh` (browser device login) or `npx agentops-cli connect`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): features, server quick start for all four deployment methods, connecting a coding tool, CLI reference, architecture overview.
- [OpenAPI spec](docs/openapi.yaml): full REST API reference, ~100 routes across auth (including CLI device login), team, repos/indexing, search, graph, usage, docbrain, and webhooks.
- [Rendered API docs](docs/index.html): browsable version of the OpenAPI spec.
- [Notes vault protocol](docs/vault-protocol.md): how agents record gotchas/decisions (remote `add_note` vs. local Markdown).
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the full plain-text content of this project's docs in one file, for loading complete context in a single request.
- [Engineering docs](docs/engineering/00-index.md): architecture, data model, MCP/REST contracts, security, operations and ADRs.

## Deployment

- [Dockerfile](Dockerfile) / [docker-compose.yml](docker-compose.yml): `app` (API + web UI) and `marketing` services; optional `postgres` and `caddy` profiles.
- [install.sh](install.sh): classic terminal installer — downloads binaries, hands off to `agentops init`.
- [ecosystem.config.js](ecosystem.config.js): PM2 deployment (server + web UI as two managed processes).
- [deploy/k8s/](deploy/k8s/): raw Kubernetes manifests (Deployment, Service, Ingress, PVC, marketing site, optional Postgres StatefulSet).
- [.env.example](.env.example): every configuration variable, with the one required value called out.

## CLI

- `agentops install|status|repos|forget|docgen|changelog|note|ingest-notes|search|explain|watch` — scan a repo into the graph and work with it.
- `agentops connect [--remote <server-url>] [--global] [--no-hooks] [--compress-commands]` — connect a coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, or any other Ruler-supported agent) by registering the MCP server and distributing AGENTS.md/skills. Without `--remote`: local stdio server against a locally scanned repo. With `--remote`: the hosted server's `/mcp` endpoint, authenticated via browser device login (default) or a personal API key.
- `agentops usage sync|report` — Claude Code session token/cost tracking, and offline replay of where context went.
- `agentops librarian export-labels|dry-run` — evaluate cheap models (Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible) at cataloguing gotchas.
- `agentops task ...` — native task management with Linear sync.
- `agentops serve|serve-api|docbrain-serve` — run the stdio MCP server, the REST API server, or the docbrain-only MCP server.
- `agentops sync-docs|api-key|init|migrate-graph` — dependency doc auto-registration, instance API key generation, first-run setup wizard, SQLite→Postgres graph migration.
